notice: Illustrative starting playbook only. These positions are not legal standards, lawyer-approved advice, or a substitute for the user's negotiated positions. Configure for each organisation and transaction.

RED.meaning: Material exposure, unusual obligation, missing essential protection, or potential legal/compliance blocker
RED.action: Escalate to qualified counsel or authorised decision-maker before acceptance

YELLOW.meaning: Meaningful deviation, ambiguity, one-sided term, or issue needing business/legal review
YELLOW.action: Review and negotiate; document rationale for acceptance

GREEN.meaning: No material issue detected against this limited checklist
GREEN.action: Continue ordinary approval; this is not a legal-validity certification

positions.default_position: Clearly define a proportionate, commercially agreed cap and identify any negotiated carve-outs
positions.acceptable_range: Transaction-specific; no universal cap is assumed
escalation_triggers: cap excludes broad categories without rationale
cap is unclear or internally inconsistent

positions.default_position: Define covered claims, procedure, control of defence, mitigation and settlement consent
positions.acceptable_range: Allocate risk to the party best able to control it
escalation_triggers: indemnity covers the indemnified party's own negligence or breach without clear allocation

positions.default_position: State termination rights, notice, cure period where agreed, and consequences
positions.acceptable_range: Depends on contract type and deal context
escalation_triggers: unilateral immediate termination without objective trigger

positions.default_position: Define confidential information, permitted use, exclusions, recipients, safeguards and return/deletion
positions.acceptable_range: Duration and exceptions depend on information and applicable law

positions.default_position: Identify roles, purpose, instructions, security, incident notice, retention/deletion and transfer controls
positions.acceptable_range: Map obligations to actual processing and applicable Indian law
escalation_triggers: personal data processing without defined purpose or safeguards

positions.default_position: Identify background IP, newly created IP, licence/assignment scope, territory, duration and consideration
positions.acceptable_range: Must reflect actual commercial bargain and statutory formalities

positions.default_position: Specify governing law, forum/seat where relevant, escalation and dispute mechanism
positions.acceptable_range: Must be coherent with transaction and enforceability review

positions.default_position: Define amount, milestones, invoice trigger, due date, taxes, withholding and disputed invoice process
positions.acceptable_range: Commercially negotiated; do not infer rates or tax treatment

nda_checklist.label: Confidential information definition and standard exclusions
Permitted representatives and responsibility for them
Personal data/security obligations if personal data is shared
